name: saobei-invoice-data-query
description: Provides digital e-invoice (fapiao) data query for Saobei merchants via the Saobei Merchant Service connector. This skill should be used when a merchant asks how many invoices were issued, the invoiced amount, the effective invoiced amount, the blue or red invoice breakdown, or asks to filter invoices by store, time range, issue status or invoice source, or asks to view invoice details or a single invoice, or download an invoice PDF. This skill only queries, counts, displays details and provides download entries; it never issues, red-flushes or authorizes invoices. Degrades gracefully when the connector is unavailable instead of returning an empty answer.
